names.note: Read out of doxologia.ro's line for 24 mai, «Sfântul Mucenic Serapion».

Read out of saint.gr's line for 24 Μαΐου, which names him inside Meletius's company as «Σεραπίων ο Aιγύπτιος», with the epithet kept and the rank word left off; the life page's own head line for him reads «Αγιος Σεραπιων ο Aιγυπτιος».

The heading of the calendar’s name link 1960, «Святитель Серапион Египтянин, Галатийский, епископ, сщмч.», with the rank word before the name and the two after it left off. Both epithets are kept because both are the calendar’s own and the comma between them is the calendar’s: the Egyptian, of Galatia. The day line gives «Серапиона египтянина», with the first of them in lower case. `fk.mjs` returned NONE for the form before the write.

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 24 мая ст. ст. — «Мчч. Мелетия Стратилата, Стефана , Иоанна , Серапиона египтянина, Каллиника волхва, Феодора и Фавста , и с ними 1218 воинов с женами и детьми (ок. 218).»

attestations.note: He is the fourth name of the line, «Серапиона египтянина», and the calendar gives him a paragraph of his own at the end of the company’s life: born in Egypt, he came to the province of Galatia, was a witness of the martyrdom of Meletius and his company, believed at the sight of the courage with which they died for Christ, was imprisoned for it, and in the prison an angel of God came down to him «и посвятил святого Серапиона во епископа», consecrated him bishop. THE RUSSIAN MAKES HIM A BISHOP WHERE THE GREEK GAVE HIM NO RANK AT ALL: name page 1960 heads him «Святитель Серапион Египтянин, Галатийский, епископ, сщмч.» and the life tells how he came by the office. `hierarch`, `bishop` and `hieromartyr` were added on that authority and `office` set to the bare «Bishop» — not a see, the calendar naming none and BRIEF-ADDENDUM §4 recording what a see-bearing office costs. `dates` WAS WRITTEN WHERE THERE WAS NONE: the folder had no `dates` object, and the interval written is the one the rest of this company already carries, the reign the calendar itself prints, «(218–222)», with the line’s «(ок. 218)» inside it. azbyka.ru was not read.

source.text: Calendarul zilei, Doxologia (doxologia.ro), 24 mai — «Sfântul Mucenic Serapion»
saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 24ης Μαΐου — «Άγιος Μελέτιος ο στρατηλάτης και οι συν αυτώ Μάρτυρες … Σεραπίων ο Aιγύπτιος …»

attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 24 Μαΐου εκάστου έτους», the same civil day on which doxologia.ro prints the bare line «Sfântul Mucenic Serapion» that this folder was made from, and it gives him the company and the death the Romanian line withholds: he is «Σεραπίων ο Αιγύπτιος», the idolater who believed when he saw Meletius the Stratelates break the temple idols by his prayer, and was beheaded. **The match is on the day and on the name, which is the whole of what either source gives to match on**, and the Greek adds an epithet — the Egyptian — and a place in a company of twenty-two named martyrs under Elagabalus, 218 to 222. The folder's own text already says that the corpus's three other Serapions are kept on other days. No hymn is printed to him; his couplet says the martyr, not sacrificing to carved things, has his neck cut through by a worshipper of carved things.
Not checked: the Ohrid Prologue at pravoslavno.rs for the corresponding Julian day (24 September 2026).

death.note: The folder had no `dates` object at all. The reign the Russian calendar prints for the whole company, «в царствование римского императора Антонина Гелиогобала (218–222)», with the day line’s «(ок. 218)» falling inside it; it is the same interval the other folders of this company already carry. The calendar gives him no year of his own, and no year of birth appears anywhere; none was inferred, and the consecration in prison is not dated.
